# scripts/Showcase/ShowNight.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Showcase/ShowNight.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Five-act story for maps/npc_showcase.gd, executed by ShowDirector.
Beats cue intruder actions, world predicates, cinematic subjects, and weather while guard AI remains live.
subjects() resolves story names/groups; ending methods report the resulting escape, defeat, or victory.

Base: `RefCounted`. Registered class: `none`.
